gloss: by all means, at any cost

definitions.gloss: by all means, without fail, at any cost
definitions.explanation: An emphatic form of ぜひ, expressing a strong desire or request. Conveys that the speaker is very earnest about wanting something to happen.

examples.japanese: {是非|ぜひ}とも⟦お{越|こ}し→お越し：07322_okoshi⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please do come, by all means.

examples.japanese: {是非|ぜひ}とも⟦{成功|せいこう}→成功：02638_seikou⟧⟦させたい→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I want to make it succeed at any cost.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{機会|きかい}→機会：01302_kikai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{是非|ぜひ}とも⟦{活|い}かして→活かす：10422_ikasu⟧⟦いただきたい→いただく：01326_itadaku⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{思|おも}います→思う：00492_omou⟧。
examples.english: I very much hope you will make the most of this opportunity.

notes:
USAGE:
{是非|ぜひ}とも is a stronger, more emphatic version of ⟦{是非|ぜひ}→是非：19460_zehi⟧ ("by all means, definitely"). It adds extra urgency or earnestness to requests and wishes. Often used in formal or polite contexts to show sincerity.

COMPARISON WITH {是非|ぜひ}:
- ⟦{是非|ぜひ}→是非：19460_zehi⟧⟦{来|き}て→来る：00254_kuru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧: Please come. (polite request)
- {是非|ぜひ}とも⟦{来|き}て→来る：00254_kuru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧: Please do come, by all means. (more emphatic)

REGISTER:
Slightly more formal than ⟦{是非|ぜひ}→是非：19460_zehi⟧ alone. Common in business settings and formal invitations.
